Members can be removed at any time. Their dashboards are not deleted: they are transferred to the Admin who removed them.

## 5. Signing in

### 5.1 Password and two-factor authentication

Members sign in with their e-mail address and a password, unless the workspace uses single sign-on. We strongly recommend turning on two-factor authentication from **Profile → Security**.
